data.description: ## Summary Update brainstorm SKILL.md with two changes: (a) When invoked with no arguments, show a selectable list of open/unblocked epics with 0 children via sprint-list-epics.sh --max-children=0, plus a "start fresh" option. Show count of >0-child epics below the list. When no 0-child epics exist, automatically fall through to fresh dialogue. (b) Fix Phase 1 Gate Step 2 gap analysis to ask one question at a time instead of batching up to 3. ## TDD Exemption Static assets only (criterion 3 — Markdown documentation, no executable conditional logic). Behavioral regression covered by skill eval suite (run-skill-evals.sh); SC7 defines post-delivery dogfooding. ## File Impact - plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md (modify) ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes (exit 0)   Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && bash tests/run-all.sh - [ ] ruff check passes (exit 0)   Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py - [ ] ruff format --check passes (exit 0)   Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py - [ ] No-args path calls sprint-list-epics.sh --max-children=0   Verify: grep -q 'sprint-list-epics.sh --max-children=0' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md - [ ] "start fresh" option described in no-args path   Verify: grep -qi 'start fresh' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md - [ ] Fallthrough to fresh dialogue when no 0-child epics   Verify: grep -qi 'fall.*through\|automatically.*fresh' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md - [ ] Count of >0-child epics displayed below the no-args epic list   Verify: grep -A5 'max-children=0' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md | grep -qi 'epics.*with.*children\|child.*count' - [ ] Old batched gap analysis phrase removed (tombstone)   Verify: ! grep -q 'at most 3 targeted questions' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md - [ ] New one-at-a-time gap analysis instruction present   Verify: grep -qi 'one question at a time\|one.*at.*a.*time' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
data.title: Update brainstorm SKILL.md — no-args epic selection + gap analysis one-at-a-time fix
